sources.title: Induction of pluripotent stem cells from mouse embryonic and adult fibroblast cultures by defined factors
supports: mouse fibroblast reprogramming to an embryonic-like pluripotent state
sources.limits: Foundational mouse-cell result; does not establish in-vivo rejuvenation or human therapeutic safety.

sources.title: Induction of pluripotent stem cells from adult human fibroblasts by defined factors
supports: generation of iPS cells from adult human dermal fibroblasts
use of Oct3/4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc in the human follow-up
sources.limits: Cell-culture reprogramming result, not a demonstration of therapeutic rejuvenation in an intact human body.

sources.title: 2012 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine press release
supports: Yamanaka and Gurdon's shared 2012 Nobel Prize

sources.title: In Vivo Amelioration of Age-Associated Hallmarks by Partial Reprogramming
supports: preserved tissue identity under the study protocol
sources.limits: Progeria mouse model of accelerated aging, not ordinary human aging; translational safety and efficacy remained unresolved.

sources.title: In vivo OSKM reprogramming, teratoma formation, and cyclic dosing mitigation
supports: uncontrolled in-vivo reprogramming can produce teratomas and loss of cell identity
cyclic dosing can reduce severe failure modes in mouse models
sources.limits: Mouse-model safety evidence; does not establish a durable therapeutic window in humans.

sources.title: ER-100 first-in-human Phase 1 study
supports: registered first-in-human Phase 1 testing of ER-100
testing in open-angle glaucoma and NAION
sources.limits: A registered and initiated study is not completed safety or efficacy evidence.

sources.title: Life Biosciences Announces FDA Clearance of IND Application for ER-100 in Optic Neuropathies
supports: Phase 1 safety-led development in optic neuropathies
sources.limits: Sponsor announcement; IND clearance permits testing and does not imply FDA judgment of efficacy.

sources.title: Life Biosciences Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1 Trial of ER-100 for Optic Neuropathies
supports: local ocular program evaluating safety/tolerability with visual-function endpoints
sources.limits: Sponsor-reported dosing milestone; no completed peer-reviewed human outcome dataset yet establishes systemic rejuvenation, lifespan extension, or long-term cancer safety.
